name: Lightpanda
description: Lightpanda is a headless browser built from scratch for AI agents and automation. It runs JavaScript and speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol, so Puppeteer and Playwright scripts work against it, and it has a built-in MCP server for AI agents.

notes.text: Neither server has authentication. Anyone who can reach ports 9222 and 9223 can browse the web through this container, so keep it on a trusted network.
Connect Puppeteer or Playwright to ws://<IP>:9222. Add http://<IP>:9223/mcp to your AI agent as an HTTP MCP server.
Requests to private and internal IPs are blocked so an agent can't be steered into your LAN. Remove --block-private-networks from both service files to browse internal sites.
